questions.prompt: What does the figure of 5,700 hectares describe?
options: The land acquired in 2024 for the reserve.
The area used only for grazing cattle.
The combined size of all King’s Series reserves.
The wider Dorset Downs landscape around the site.
questions.explanationZh: 334公顷是保护区；5700公顷是更大的多塞特丘陵地区。

questions.prompt: Why are cattle introduced at Lyscombe?
options: To replace the farming with a new visitor attraction.
To help maintain grassland and stop bushes spreading.
To move all conservation work away from the chapel.
To increase the amount of land used for intensive farming.
questions.explanationZh: 放牧有助于保持白垩草地、防止灌木扩张，是保护管理方式。

questions.prompt: Which improvement is reported beyond the reserve itself?
options: New wildlife corridors have connected nearby towns.
Less intensive farming has increased local food sales.
Water quality farther along the River Piddle has improved.
Historic buildings across Dorset have gained protected status.
questions.explanationZh: 公告报告污染减少和下游水质改善，不是其他选项的结果。

questions.prompt: Which view of managing Lyscombe best matches the article?
options: Conservation combines grazing, natural regeneration and heritage protection.
Conservation centres on restoring buildings and relocating the grassland.
Conservation prioritises intensive farming and creating new woodland.
Conservation focuses on river work rather than managing the grassland.
questions.explanationZh: 全文把放牧、自然更新、农业及历史保护结合起来；没有宣称停止农业或只修建筑。
